data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 7.232m for the 2017 financial year, calculated from the gross claims development triangle. This release was primarily driven by favourable claims development, particularly within the nuclear property class. Specific events from prior years, such as a dropped steam generator reserve from 2016 that was not required, contributed to this positive development.

data.data_quality_notes: The report states a 'release of GBP 10.1m of technical reserves in respect of prior years' (page 23), but the Managing Agent's Report (page 9) links this to a 'reduction in net incurred claims', implying it's a net figure. The gross prior year development calculated from the gross claims development triangle (page 29) is -7.232m. The triangle figure is used as it represents gross movement.
